title: Vestibular Rehabilitation and Dizziness
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether vestibular exercises provide added benefit to balance rehabilitation in older adults with dizziness and normal vestibular function.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* at least 50 years of age
* documented balance or mobility problems
* normal vestibular function, including otolith function

Exclusion Criteria:

* cognitive impairment
* progressive medical issues that would impact mobility (e.g., Parkinson's disease, cerebellar atrophy)
* dizziness due to orthostatic hypotension or Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)
